The single-line PubMed query is saved in [final_strategy.txt](C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-05063212dadf5296/ours-codex-noseed-20260927T142823Z/final_strategy.txt). The full strategy, line counts, scope assumptions, and audit are in [audit.md](C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-05063212dadf5296/ours-codex-noseed-20260927T142823Z/work/audit.md).

With the 2020-05-15 publication cutoff, PubMed returned **583 records**. The query retrieved all **27 screened relevant records**: 19 development records and 8 held-out validation records. This is relative recall on a pilot-derived set, not an estimate of sensitivity. No web search or post-cutoff literature was used.

The scope was not personally confirmed because you asked me to proceed without questions. The two internal critique rounds resolved their findings; an information specialist’s PRESS peer review is still pending.
